verdict.rationale: Poly ships a Journaling feature in Poly Mind, described as a place to document day-to-day life, and new journal entries are saved as Markdown files in the Mind folder. That gives a basic journaling and capture surface. Nothing in the pack shows entries being created automatically per day, pre-filled from a template, or serving as the default landing page. Missing for 10: automatic per-day note creation, template pre-fill, daily note as default landing place, independent or hands-on corroboration.
